dialogue.chat: A chat! Perfect cooldown. Talk fast though — my legs get ideas if I stand still too long, %1$s.
dialogue.chat/1: Perfect cooldown, a chat. Talk quick — standing still gives my legs ideas.
dialogue.chat/2: Got breath to spare between drills. Out with it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations: Talk? Sure. Walk with me though — two more laps around the fences before sundown. Keep up, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations/1: Sure, but keep it moving. I think clearer with wind in my face, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations/2: Talk away — I'll stretch, you speak. Efficient.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Great stretch. Beat my own time to the well three mornings running. Legs ache. The good ache.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Strong. Lungs like a forge bellows and legs that won't quit. Good week.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: Never better. Every muscle's earned its keep today.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Rough week. Tried to outrun it twice and it kept pace. Thanks for asking, %1$s. Really.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: Off my stride. A body that won't cooperate is a long few days. Kind of you to ask.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: Same as an hour ago, %1$s — winded and standing. Ask my legs, they don't lie.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: Twice now? Still breathing hard, still upright. That's a good report in my book.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: Strong day. Up before the rooster, ten trips to the well, still bouncing. Count them — ten.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Legs like springs today. Even the hills felt friendly, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: Slow day. Tweaked my shoulder hauling water and now everything's uphill. Even the flat parts.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Rest day, cleric's orders. I'm pacing the yard like a penned horse.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: Love it. It's all reps. Lift, carry, repeat till dusk. Sleep like a rock, wake up hungry, go again.
dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: It's paid training, really. Every haul makes me stronger. Can't beat that.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: Honest answer? It's the standing still that kills me. My legs get bored long before I do.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: Only the tallying. Give me the carrying — my legs want a job, not a ledger.
dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s has long walls and good hills — the finest training ground a body could ask for.
dialogue.conversations.village.home/1: Ran every street in %2$s twice this week. It's home, and it's my racecourse.
dialogue.conversations.people.first: Good sparring stock, most of them. The smith arm-wrestles like a bear — I'm owed a rematch.
dialogue.conversations.people.first/1: Solid folk. Raced half, hauled water for the rest. That's how you get to know a village, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.food.first: Anything hearty and plenty of it. A body this busy runs on fuel, not frills.
dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Big plates, no fuss. I've earned every bite by noon and then some.
dialogue.conversations.life.first: My story? Born fast, stayed fast. Raced everything — kids, chickens, one very smug goat. Still owe that goat a rematch.
dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: All motion, my life. The still bits I forget; the finish lines I never do.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: One dream: outrun a horse. Ten strides, that's all I need. I've already paced the course behind the barn.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: To still be running when I'm grey. Slower, fine. But running, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: Truth? The day my knees quit. Everything I am is in these legs. What's left of me when they slow down?
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: Rusting. Sitting still till the body forgets how to move. I outrun that one daily.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: You're the only one who keeps up with me, %1$s. In every way that counts. That's rarer than you think.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first/1: You're the one I'd slow down for. Don't go telling my legs, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: Whoa — steep hill for a first run. Train with me a while and we'll climb it together, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: That's a cool-down talk, and we've just started warming up. Keep coming round.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: That question's a marathon and we're still on morning stretches. Keep showing up. You're pacing well.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: That's the far end of a long course. We're pacing there. Not yet.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Nothing. Quietest week all season. I raced the miller's dog out of sheer boredom. Twice. Won once.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: No news. I'd have outrun it to you if there were, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happy? You're my favorite finish line and my reason to start again. Yes, easily.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/1: With you I stopped feeling like I was running FROM something. That's rare. That's you.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage: Big news off the track, %1$s — %2$s and %3$s tied the knot! Two runners, one finish line now. Love it.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage/1: %2$s and %3$s finally crossed the line together — married! About time they paced up.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce: Heard %2$s and %3$s called it quits. Some races you run solo, I guess. No shame in a fresh start.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce/1: %2$s and %3$s split — parted ways mid-stride. Happens. They'll each find their own lane.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: Sad word, %1$s — %2$s passed. Ran a good long course, that one. I'll do a lap in their honor.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/1: We lost %2$s. Every race ends somewhere. Doesn't make the finish any easier, though.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: New sprinter in the village — %2$s was born! Tiny legs, big future. Can't wait to race 'em someday.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/1: %2$s just arrived — a brand-new baby! Off the starting blocks already. Welcome to the pack, little one.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival: Fresh face in town — %2$s just moved in. Already challenged 'em to a lap around the fences. Good sport.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival/1: %2$s joined the village! New training partner, far as I'm concerned. The more the merrier.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure: %2$s packed up and moved on for good. Off to run new roads, I suppose. Wish 'em a strong pace.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure/: Heard %2$s left the village. Every athlete moves to a new field eventually. Godspeed, and keep those legs moving.
